The job sends one request per invoice, but the provider only allows a hundred a minute, so after the first hundred, every remaining request was refused. This means forty-one hundred invoices never went out, and customers will get them a day late unless we re-run the job before nine in the morning. Re-running now is safe, as the provider ignores already seen invoices. We can re-run it now with a quick fix and then do the proper fix, or apply the proper fix first. What would you like to do?
